question: When retained exposure flicker, density-conditioned temporal grain and scanner-stage gate weave are composed in physical order, does each switch retain a visible, reproducible and distinguishable effect signature?
forbidden: merge exposure, grain and gate-weave controls into one unlabeled random seed
move any effect across its typed physical boundary
chain scanner resampling from prior output frames
change parent profiles, frames, switches or gates after formal scoring
claim synthetic effect separability is measured film-video quality or product readiness

branch_rule.pass: retain the three effects as independently switchable typed temporal reference stages and next challenge shot-boundary state semantics
branch_rule.fail: close the combined temporal reference without amplitude, seed, order or threshold rescue

claim_ceiling: Synthetic joint-ablation evidence for three retained generic temporal mechanisms only; not measured film stock, camera, transport, scanner, photographic video quality or product readiness.
